surfaceMeaning: Unmapped surface: the standard grid is a coordinate aid, not observed color or terrain.
orientationMeaning: Illustrative ICRF north pole (RA 0°, Dec +90°), arbitrary prime meridian and phase. No measured body pole or absolute surface attitude is claimed.
axesStatus: Illustrative equal axes at the published effective diameter; these are not three independently measured axes.
radiusMeaning: Volume-equivalent radius of the chosen illustrative equal-axis model, not a measured 3D-volume radius.
name: Orcus
periodText: Possibly synchronized with Vanth’s roughly 9.54-day orbit; no qualified sidereal spin is installed.
credit: Brown and Butler (2018), resolved ALMA binary photometry with Spitzer/Herschel thermal modeling.
shapeMeaning: Size-constrained spherical illustration at Orcus’s primary-only thermal diameter, 910 +50/−40 km. ALMA separated the binary components but did not resolve Orcus’s terrain or measure three shape axes.
introduction: Orcus is a large resonant world beyond Neptune, partnered with the substantial moon Vanth. The displayed size belongs to Orcus alone; its smooth shape and grid surface are illustrative.
